title: Anker PowerCore 10000 Portable Charger
description_en: Anker Japan's top-selling portable charger — 10,000mAh fits in a shirt pocket and charges an iPhone 4× over. Built with Anker's proprietary MultiProtect safety system. The lightest 10000mAh battery pack on the market at 180g.
description_ja: Anker Japanの売上No.1モバイルバッテリー。10,000mAhでiPhoneを約4回充電。シャツのポケットに入る薄さ・軽さ180g。MultiProtect安全システムで安心の品質。
